$comment: The core test matrix of the focus round (docs/FOCUS.md section 6). One row per core interaction. `feature` names the section 2 feature the row belongs to, so the rule "a core feature with a not driven or failed row is parked for the ship" is computed from this file by the run and never typed. `today` is what the focus audits saw on production at ec61c6b on 2026-09-15: works, broken, flaky or not driven; a not driven row carries no severity and a works row carries none either (a `note` records where the row's criterion differs from the audit's). `severity` sits on broken and flaky rows only, as the audits set it. `evidence` names the audit row or the file. `driver` names what drives the row: the editor walk probe in --core mode, or the spec file under apps/studio/e2e/core/. `setup` names a window API write made before the driven steps and never counted as one. Interaction texts carry the time bound the run checks. Rendered into docs/FOCUS.md by docs/gslides-parity/focus/render-focus.mjs; the probe's --core mode reads the ids.
